content:
Aisha: Kicking off NebulaHealth private deployment smoke run. Quick check: network reachability, egress validation, IAM roles, KMS access, and audit log delivery to Splunk. Any obvious blockers?
Marco: Can you confirm the customer CIDR and BGP peer IPs? I pulled 10.40.0.0/16 but want the final.
Sam (Customer): confirmed: CIDR is 10.40.0.0/16, peer IP is 198.51.100.22. We'll NAT from their edge.
Marco: OK. One net snag: their firewall team is only opening outbound 443 right now; we need TCP 5222 for the control-plane agent and UDP 51820 for wireguard. @Aisha can you nudge them?
Aisha: pinged firewall team +DMed Sam to escalate. Also raised a runbook task: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/privnet-onboard#nebulahealth
Priya: From security side: KMS policy needs to include the service principal for redwood-priv-svc in addition to the account IAM roles. I flagged a small permission gap in their policy.
Sam (Customer): thanks — can you paste the minimal policy snippet?
Priya: Sure — use the least-priv snippet below and attach to the KMS key policy:
```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-priv-svc"},
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```
Elena: Observability note — NebulaHealth asked for 90-day audit retention. Our default forwarding adds a Splunk index named redwood_priv_audit. Confirmed ingestion format is JSONL.
Jon: On IAM: please ensure the cross-account role name matches `RedwoodPrivAccess`. We had a mismatch in another customer where role ARN used `redwood_priv_access` (underscore) and it failed.
Aisha: Action items summary: 1) Sam escalate firewall for TCP5222 & UDP51820 (Sam) 2) Customer attach KMS snippet (Sam + Priya) 3) Create cross-account role `RedwoodPrivAccess` (Sam) 4) Console: enable audit-forwarding to `redwood_priv_audit` (Elena) 5) Net validation test (Marco/Jon).
Sam (Customer): I'll queue this with our infra team today, ETA EOD.
Marco: Once firewall is open, I'll run `nc -vz 198.51.100.22 5222` and `sudo wg show` smoke checks.
Aisha: FYI renewal signal: billing flagged this account as potential early renewal (heavy usage forecast). Capture any onboarding delays — if we hit >72h blocker we should loop in AM.
Priya: One more security ask: please confirm CloudTrail multi-region enabled and that S3 bucket for logs has Object Lock disabled (we have an indexer issue otherwise).
Aisha: Noted. Sam, can you confirm CloudTrail setting?
Sam (Customer): CloudTrail is multi-region but bucket settings defaulted by infra team; will check object lock.
ops-bot: deploy-checklist passed partial (network pending). See https://redwood.internal/ops/checks/1778888000
Elena: I'll capture the feedback and add to the onboarding retro doc once we close — small wins: KMS snippet clarity helped, friction: firewall ports not documented in initial docs. I'll update the quickstart.
Aisha: thanks all — I'll reconvene in 24 hrs or sooner if firewall opened. :thumbsup:
